title: Catastrophic Flood Hits Nepal, Engulfing Crowds and Causing Quake
summary_full: The authorities reported hundreds of people missing and at least 160 people killed in the border region of Nepal and Tibet, where an avalanche of mud, water, ice and rocks smashed down.
